# Runtime dependencies. Nothing here is imported until a connector that
# needs it is actually called, so install only the rows you use.
#
# Always:
azure-identity>=1.15          # TokenCredential: managed identity, CLI, service principal
#
# Read and write planes, one per connector:
gremlinpython>=3.6            # GremlinConnector / GremlinElements — Cosmos DB Gremlin
azure-kusto-data>=4.3         # KqlConnector      — Fabric Eventhouse / Data Explorer
azure-search-documents>=11.5  # SearchConnector / SearchDocuments / SearchIndexProvisioner
azure-cosmos>=4.5,<5          # CosmosContainer / CosmosItems — Cosmos DB NoSQL
httpx>=0.27                   # GraphConnector    — Fabric GraphModel (GQL over HTTPS)
#
# Deploy plane only. Separate rows because a process that reads and writes
# data has no reason to carry a management SDK.
azure-mgmt-search>=9.1        # SearchServiceProvisioner
azure-mgmt-cosmosdb>=10       # Cosmos and Gremlin provisioners
azure-mgmt-kusto>=3.3         # KustoClusterProvisioner / KustoDatabaseProvisioner
                              #   (the table is a data-plane control command)
#
# The live topology only — azdata.live. The resource group and the Log
# Analytics workspace are generic ARM writes, and the SPEC 7.4 role
# assignments are a management plane of their own.
azure-mgmt-resource>=23       # resource group, Log Analytics workspace
azure-mgmt-authorization>=4   # role assignments
#
# Two version notes that are load-bearing, both verified by introspection:
#
# * azure-cosmos 4.x removed ``enable_cross_partition_query``. A query is
#   cross-partition exactly when no ``partition_key`` is passed. The 4.x
#   pin is upper-bounded because a 5.x that reinstates or renames that
#   behaviour would change what a scoped query means (GOTCHAS.md G17).
# * azure-mgmt-search 9.x is msrest-style: models expose ``as_dict()``
#   returning flattened snake_case. azure-mgmt-cosmosdb 10.x is the newer
#   JSON-backed style: models are Mappings carrying nested camelCase REST
#   payloads. azure-mgmt-kusto 4.x is the JSON-backed style too, verified
#   by introspection: ``isinstance(Cluster(...), Mapping)`` is True and
#   ``as_dict()`` nests under ``properties`` in camelCase. The deploy
#   plane normalises all three; a downgrade of any of them breaks drift
#   detection silently (GOTCHAS.md G18).
#
# tests/ needs none of them: every SDK is substituted through
# azdata.core.optional.override. Python 3.11+ (asyncio.timeout).
